item.title: Rising insurance costs drive Florida voters toward 2026 midterm elections, study finds
item.description: The cost of homeowners insurance is becoming a key political issue in Florida, where 65 percent of respondents say rising insurance costs would make them more likely to vote in the 2026 midterms.

item.title: Palm Beach County commissioners deny private Christian school proposal in Jupiter Farms
item.description: Palm Beach County commissioners voted to deny a controversial proposal to build a large private Christian school in Jupiter Farms after hours of emotional public debate over traffic, growth and the future of the community's rural character.

item.title: Fort Pierce residents pack planning meeting over 17-story Causeway Cove high-rise proposal
item.description: The Fort Pierce Planning Board reviewed the Causeway Cove development project on Monday as neighbors packed the chamber. item.title: World Cup semifinals set with England facing Argentina
item.description: England and Argentina advanced to the World Cup semifinals over the weekend, joining Spain and France to complete the final four.

item.title: Linda Noskova wins first Grand Slam title at Wimbledon
item.description: Linda Noskova recovered from wasting five match points in the second set to defeat Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 on Saturday in an all-Czech women's final.

item.title: Jannik Sinner beats Alexander Zverev to defend Wimbledon title
item.description: Top-ranked Jannik Sinner defeated Alexander Zverev 6-7, 7-6, 6-3, 6-4 on Sunday for his second consecutive Wimbledon championship and fifth Grand Slam title.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap with nine road widening projects unfunded
item.description: Martin County will need approximately $2.8 billion for transportation improvements over the next 20 years but only $701 million is currently available, leaving nine identified road widening projects without funding.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Opens Registration for Free City University Program
item.description:
Registration is now open for Port St. Lucie City University, a free nine-session program designed to help residents better understand how their local government operates.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
